rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a camera, especially a still/photo camera.

example.english: My camera has run out of battery.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 soeng2 gei1 mou5 din6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the camera is specifically a video-recording or camcorder device rather than a still camera.

example.english: The camera is recording the wedding.
example.jyutping: bou6 sip3 luk6 gei1 jing2 gan2 fan1 lai5
